# Xenotrix Technologies

> Building Products, Platforms & Digital Solutions for Modern Businesses.

Headquartered in Thiruvilwamala, Thrissur, Kerala, India (co-founded in 2025 by **Sanjay S**, **Abi C R**, and **Hari Govind**), Xenotrix Technologies operates globally, delivering proprietary software products, enterprise microservices, AI integrations, Flutter mobile apps, high-conversion websites, and digital transformation solutions.

## Co-Founders & Leadership

- **Sanjay S**: Co-Founder & Principal Full-Stack & Cloud Architect (Full-Stack Microservices, Database Engineering & Cloud Infrastructure, Frontend Architecture, and Data Analytics & BI)
- **Abi C R**: Co-Founder & AI / Machine Learning Lead (AI Integration, Machine Learning, LLM Agents & RAG, Vector Search)
- **Hari Govind**: Co-Founder & Product Operations & Mobile Engineering Lead (Product Operations, Enterprise Scoping, Digital Growth, Technical SEO, and Mobile App Development in Flutter)

## Proprietary Software Products

- [XenoCRM](https://xenotrix.in/products/xenocrm): CRM and business relationship management platform unifying customer pipelines, automated multi-channel messaging, sales tracking, and operational intelligence.
- [XenoFin](https://xenotrix.in/products/xenofin): Financial and business management platform with real-time cash flow telemetry, automated ledger reconciliation, and taxation compliance.
- [XenoBiz](https://xenotrix.in/products/xenobiz): Mobile-based billing software designed for small businesses and shop owners combining billing, khata ledgers, inventory, and WhatsApp messaging.
- [XenoClass](https://xenotrix.in/products/xenoclass): Learning Management System (LMS) for education and training with interactive virtual classrooms and automated progress tracking.
- [XenoHR](https://xenotrix.in/products/xenohr): Human Resource Management platform orchestrating onboarding, biometric attendance, automated payroll, and leave workflows.
- [Xenotune](https://xenotrix.in/products/xenotune): AI-powered ambient music platform utilizing procedural acoustic synthesis for focus, relaxation, and circadian recovery.

## Commercial Engineering Practices & Services

- [Website Development](https://xenotrix.in/services/website-development): High-speed corporate websites, custom portals, sub-second Core Web Vitals, and conversion engineering in Kerala, India & UAE.
- [Web Application Development](https://xenotrix.in/services/web-application-development): Scalable multi-tenant SaaS systems, real-time client dashboards, FastAPI/React backends.
- [E-Commerce Development](https://xenotrix.in/services/ecommerce-development): Headless eCommerce storefronts, payment gateways (Razorpay, Stripe), WhatsApp commerce & inventory sync.
- [Mobile App Development](https://xenotrix.in/services/mobile-app-development): 60fps Flutter mobile applications for iOS & Android, offline-first SQLite architectures.
- [Custom Software Development](https://xenotrix.in/services/custom-software-development): Bespoke business operating systems, microservices, and database engineering.
- [CRM & ERP Development](https://xenotrix.in/services/crm-erp-development): All-in-one CRM/ERP software, GST billing, inventory, and WhatsApp CRM pipelines.
- [AI Solutions & Automation](https://xenotrix.in/services/ai-automation): Autonomous AI agents, enterprise RAG knowledge vaults, WhatsApp AI chatbots, n8n workflow automation.
- [Digital Marketing & SEO](https://xenotrix.in/services/digital-marketing-seo): Technical SEO, Schema.org engineering, local pack SEO (Kerala, Thrissur, Kochi), and conversion optimization.
- [Cloud & Deployment](https://xenotrix.in/services/cloud-deployment): Docker containerization, CI/CD pipelines, Cloudflare edge security, and 99.98% runtime SLA.
